description:
Think Clearly Again | Santoor Instrumental | 1.5 Hours to Remove Mental Blocks

When your head feels foggy and every thought runs into a wall, pushing harder rarely helps. Give your mind ninety quiet minutes instead.

This soft Indian santoor music is designed to clear mental blocks: slow, spacious notes that let a stuck mind loosen until ideas start to move again.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of gentle santoor over a steady tanpura drone, with long pauses, no drums and no vocals.

▶ Keep your mind clear — the full Meditation playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199nvhUBCx5L9ROrDP44H4JzN
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for thinking through a problem, writing, planning, studying, creative work, journaling, an evening reset after a crowded day, meditation, reading, or quiet time away from screens.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Santoor (Indian hammered strings) with tanpura drone
Raga: Durga (an open, uncluttered five-note raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, ambient
Mood: Clear, spacious, unhurried
Atmosphere: A lamp just lit, a quiet desk, the evening settling
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Put it on low, set the phone face down and give yourself one thing to think about - or nothing at all. Let each note ring out fully before the next. Headphones give the cleanest sound; soft speakers work well for a room.
